description: Category:Mutant Mania Quests — The Townstons wiki
html:
The principal theme of the Quests offered for Mutant Mania centers around the theme of the Gym and Wrestling, with some obvious takeoffs of WWE. Loremaster Vraile says "I am embarassed to admit the violent brawls contained within the MutantMania are a guilty pleasure of mine. Embarassed because I am a seeker of knowledge, a learned man! And yet ... have you seen Babyface Buster perform his "Suicide Swaddle" attack? Pure poetry in motion! We must not simply read and listen, my child. Skilled observation may also grant knowledge. Go into the MutantMania. Watch the combatants. 'Comprehend' what they do. Once you have gained a modicum of understanding for what it takes to be a professional in the MutantMania circuit, return to me."

It is a long way from L80 to L100. Therefore the quests in Mutant Mania are many, varied, and convoluted. They will keep you going back from one level to another for a long time!
